# Tactical Planning Cycle

The daily loop in which the [[entities/rover-operations-control-centre|ROCC]] plans the next sol ([[sources/rocc-glossary]]).

## Größe und Dauer

Ein Zyklus dauert etwa 24 Stunden — “quotes” and ünïcödé ([[sources/rocc-glossary]]).
